## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] Tests pass (`.venv/bin/pytest`)
- [ ] Lint and type checks pass (`.venv/bin/ruff check .` and `.venv/bin/mypy app`)
- [ ] Pull request title follows Conventional Commits (for example, `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, or `chore:`)
- [ ] Pull request targets `dev`
